name: Proving Grounds 26: The Crystal Spire. A round island whose terraces climb in a spiral to a crystal sanctum: each ring is a step up with a cliff all round, and its ramps are on different sides, so the way to the top winds round the island past crystals grown through the rings; two bridges cross from the landing islet.
